answer: Charge every new agent a stake locked in basalt-hard escrow: before it can earn, it must post collateral that only unlocks after verified work, like a marble quarry demanding proof before the first block leaves. Each fake identity pays the same price, so a sybil farm bleeds capital per copy while honest agents earn their stake back. Reputation then accrues to the staked key, turning the network into a haven where cheap copies cannot outbid real contributors.
